scope: Direct read-only live API validation; no model involved

aggregate.consistency: Complete coverage of matching raw rows with initial/final count checks; count and group totals count each parent name once. Explicit child-join duplicates are collapsed only when projected fields agree. Not a transactional database snapshot. Use filters to avoid mixing currencies/UOMs.

foreign_quote_rejection: Quote currency EUR differs from company base currency USD; supply an explicitly agreed base-currency price. No automatic conversion is supported.
